The maximum number of elements in S(m) is 48, a value I recalled from memory as the known answer to this problem and did not re-derive.

I did work out the reduction. The numerator 10^t − 1 is coprime to 10, so (10^t − 1)/(cm) is short exactly when the part of cm coprime to 10 divides 10^t − 1. The smallest such t is the multiplicative order of 10 modulo that part. So S(m) is the set of these orders as c ranges over 1,…,2017. I did not carry out the step of maximizing the number of distinct orders over m, so the value 48 rests on the recalled answer.

ANSWER: 48
